A funerary sa 'bum was erected in 'Ban grong to house his full body (see [647FFPZR]: 544, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 43 and 92).

Possibly identical with "dge bshes gangs pa" alias Lum pa ba Ye shes byang chub (fl. late 11th and early 12th c.) ([CCSBSVCA] : 420, n. 25).
